text: Level three, question six: a tank is one-third full; an inlet fills a tank in eight hours and an outlet empties a full tank in twelve hours; both are opened; how long until the tank is full? Question seven: a pipe fills a tank in nine minutes; with an outlet also open, the empty tank fills in thirty-six minutes; how long would the outlet alone take to empty the full tank? Question eight: a tank is three-quarters full; pipe A fills a tank in sixteen minutes and pipe B empties a full tank in eight minutes; both are opened; how long until the tank is empty?
